Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 45 minutes Total time: 55 minutes Number of Servings: 12 Ingredients 3/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese 1 cup chopped onion (any type) 1 cup chopped broccoli 1 cup diced tomato (fresh) 2 cups nonfat or 1% milk 4 eggs 1 cup all-purpose baking mix (for biscuits or pancakes) 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning (or basil and oregano) 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper Directions Preheat oven to 375 °F. Lightly grease 12 muffin cups. Sprinkle the cheese, onion, broccoli and tomato into the muffin cups. Place remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix until smooth. Pour mixture over ingredients in the muffin cups. Bake until golden brown or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try chopped zucchini or mushrooms as part of the vegetables. Use any variety of cheese your family likes. Bake in a pie pan instead of muffin cups (baking time will be longer).
